QF.id: Issue Management - General Obligations and Due Diligence_49

question.text: A company eligible for Fast Track Issue had its equity shares suspended from trading as a disciplinary measure for 2 days, 4 years ago. Does this affect its eligibility?

answer.text: No, the disciplinary suspension was outside the 3-year period immediately preceding the reference date, so it does not affect eligibility
Yes, any suspension in the company's entire listing history disqualifies it
Yes, suspension within the last 5 years is disqualifying
No, because the suspension was for only 2 days and short suspensions are exempt

explanation.text: The Logic: For Fast Track Issue eligibility, the equity shares must not have been suspended from trading as a disciplinary measure during the last three years immediately preceding the reference date. Here the disciplinary suspension occurred 4 years ago, i.e., outside the three-year window, so it does not affect current eligibility. The Trap: Option D gives the right conclusion but the wrong reasoning — the duration of the suspension is not the relevant criterion. The criterion is whether the suspension was disciplinary and whether it fell within the three-year period immediately preceding the reference date. Note: Suspensions of trading that are not disciplinary in nature (for example, technical or operational halts) do not by themselves trigger this disqualification.
